data.text: Anders' Mac demo runtime: please do NOT run `npm run dev` (uvicorn --reload) here. The repo is in OneDrive, which keeps touching files, so --reload restarts the backend every few seconds and the board gets timeouts/500s (observed 19:20 and again 19:41). Run the backend WITHOUT --reload: `cd apps/agent && uv run uvicorn office.api:create_app --factory --host 127.0.0.1 --port 3001 --timeout-graceful-shutdown 2`, plus `npm run dev -w @office/web`. voice_station.py is running on /dev/cu.usbmodem2101 (board mic); don't start another serial reader. Local uncommitted fixes: board_mic.py/voice_station.py (stop mic after 1.2 s silence / 4 s no speech / 10 s cap; presses while thinking/speaking are stopped and discarded) and procurement oda.py (cross-process token refresh lock; never wipe a login another client renewed).
